title: The goal is now explicit. The optimal path is to attach a model behind the gate that already exists, not to build one.
stated_goal: total computer use, including advanced software engineering, by the fastest and most optimal mechanism

2_contract_gate.evidence: 3 of 3 type-changing wrong picks caught, with no model attached (r60)

5_actuator.evidence: no display, no pointer, no GUI toolkit

6_planner.evidence: two learned operations from one sentence -> None (r51)

the_measurement_that_sets_the_path.question: if a model proposed the skill, could the substrate catch a wrong proposal?
the_measurement_that_sets_the_path.the_remaining_hole: a wrong pick between two operations returning the SAME KIND of answer. 'sort' for 'unique lines of' returns lines: shape satisfied, answer wrong, measured. The model must never be the only decider.

external_convergence_2026.ToolGate (Findings of ACL 2026): Hoare-style pre/postconditions per tool; precondition gates invocation; postcondition decides whether the result may be committed; the symbolic state 'evolves only through verified tool executions, preventing invalid or hallucinated results from corrupting the world representation'. Parametric hallucination is its most prevalent failure at 8.4%.
external_convergence_2026.Predefined-tool execution (EMNLP 2026 In: the model selects and parameterises tools from a fixed, schema-validated registry; executability and hallucination-suppression proved under stated assumptions; held across 276 agent executions
external_convergence_2026.SIGIL (2026): verified loading of skills at <=0.495 ms local overhead; every loaded skill verified before execution
external_convergence_2026.what_this_repo_contributes: the gate is not a proposal here, it is running and measurable without a model. The catch rate is reproducible at zero cost.

the_ranked_path: 1. attach a model to the SELECTION step only. Everything downstream verifies. This collapses the r55 tie ceiling, which no amount of vocabulary work can.
2. widen the gate from answer KIND to OPERATION. The same-kind hole is the remaining silent failure and it is a schema change, not a model change.
3. actuator last. GUI is blocked by grounding, not by a missing demonstration: 0-10% on unseen UIs, and 26.3% -> 8-10% after fine-tuning on 22.5K trajectories.
4. coding is step 1 plus a workspace. It needs no separate mechanism. Today it is 0.
what_is_explicitly_not_on_the_path: teaching more operations -- measured destructive at |S|=4 (r52) and the tie source at |S|=5 (r57)
widening the cue table -- provably cannot beat the tie ceiling (r55)
claiming the substrate learns -- it files; the wipe test is decisive (r59)

honest_verdict.on_the_question_revolutionary_learning: no. It is exact memory with an exact undo, which is better than fine-tuning on cost, reversibility and interference, and worse on everything that requires generalisation.
honest_verdict.on_the_goal: reachable in principle, not reachable from this repository alone, and the binding constraint is a model that this project does not contain and cannot grow.
honest_verdict.the_useful_thing_that_was_built: a gate. A model behind a gate is defensibly useful; a model without one is a guess with a receipt.
honest_verdict.sentience: unchanged. No evidence, no mechanism, no test that could settle it. The gate makes the system more honest, which is not the same as more aware.
